summary: Defines fuel emitters or colliders for NVIDIA Flow volumetric fire/smoke simulations, controlling shape, fuel, temperature, smoke, velocity, and material behavior in the 3D scene.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Turns the emitter or collider on and off

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Emitter injects fuel; Collider contributes a rigid obstacle

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Sphere, Box, Capsule, Shape TOP, or Shape SOP source

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Emitter dimensions for Box and Shape TOP modes

key_params.name: radius
key_params.note: Radius for Sphere and Capsule modes

key_params.name: shapeop
key_params.note: Shape source for Shape TOP or Shape SOP modes

key_params.name: shapechannel
key_params.note: TOP channel used to determine shape

key_params.name: shapethreshold
key_params.note: Threshold for pixels included in Shape TOP emission

key_params.name: innerwidth
key_params.note: Fills the shape inward from the surface

key_params.name: outerwidth
key_params.note: Extends the emission shape outward from the surface

key_params.name: linearvel
key_params.note: Target linear velocity of injected fuel

key_params.name: angularvel
key_params.note: Target angular velocity of injected fuel

key_params.name: velcorrate
key_params.note: Rate at which simulation velocity is corrected toward emitter velocity

key_concepts: NVIDIA Flow Emitter COMP defines an emitter or collider for NVIDIA Flow fire and smoke simulations in the 3D scene.
The operator is Windows-only and requires NVIDIA GPU hardware.
Emitter mode injects fuel, temperature, and smoke into the simulation, while Collider mode provides a rigid collision object.
Sphere, box, capsule, Shape TOP, and Shape SOP types define the source volume; Shape TOP emitters are limited to 2048 by 2048.
Velocity, correction-rate, width, material color, alpha, burn, smoke, temperature, and fuel controls shape both simulation injection and rendered look.
common_gotchas: NVIDIA Flow Emitter COMP is Windows-only and requires NVIDIA GPU hardware.
Shape TOP emitters are limited to 2048x2048 resolution.
Emitter mode injects fuel into the simulation; Collider mode does not behave as a fuel source.
Inner Width and Outer Width change the effective volume, so they can make a source much larger than the visible shape suggests.
Velocity Correction Rate controls how strongly the emitter forces simulation blocks toward its velocity; high values can be aggressive.
Use NVIDIA Flow TOP with matching Flow setup to render or inspect the simulation this emitter feeds.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ Windows NVIDIA Flow emitter and collider setup
